Card Q&A.a: Yes, you can. If an effect activates, it is to be fully resolved even if the card that activated the effect is removed from that area during the processing.
Card Q&A.q: I activated this card's [When Digivolving] effect, and when my opponent's Digimon would leave the battle area for the 1st process, an immediate-type effect such as a "when [...] would leave" effect caused this card to be removed from the battle area. Can I then process the part of the effect after "then" in this card's effect?

Card Q&A.a: The player that activated this effect chooses.
Card Q&A.q: Which player chooses the order in which the cards are returned to the deck for this card's [When Digivolving] effect?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, it's returned to the Digi-Egg deck.
Card Q&A.q: If this card's [When Digivolving] effect would return a Digi-Egg card to the deck, is it returned to the Digi-Egg deck?

Card Q&A.a: No. For each card with the [Mega] trait in digivolution cards, you choose 1 of your opponent's Digimon and delete it, but you only return 10 cards from the trash to the deck.
Card Q&A.q: Does this card's [When Digivolving] effect delete 1 of my opponent's Digimon for each card with the [Mega] trait in this card's digivolution cards and return 10 cards in my opponent's trash to the bottom of their deck for each card with the [Mega] trait in this card's digivolution cards?
Can I use this card's [When Digivolving] effect to return cards from my opponent's trash to the bottom of the deck even if they only have 9 or fewer cards in their trash?
Do I have to activate this card's [Start of Your Turn] effect?

Card Q&A.a: No, it isn't trashed. If this card doesn't have any digivolution cards, it isn't considered to have any stacked cards, therefore it isn't trashed.
Card Q&A.q: This card is in the battle area and it has no digivolution cards. Does this card's [Start of Your Turn] effect trash this card?

This card has digivolution cards, then I place 1 more card on top and digivolve it. At the start of my turn, I activate this card's [Start of Your Turn] effect and trash the top card. Does this card's [Start of Your Turn] effect activate from under it?

Effect: [When Digivolving] For each card with [Mega] in their traits in this Digimon’s digivolution cards, delete 1 of your opponent’s Digimon. Then, place 10 cards from your opponent’s trash at the bottom of their deck in any order.
[Start of Your Turn] Trash the top card of this Digimon. If you do, trash the top card of your opponent’s security stack.
